_comment: "Free alternatives to ..." pages (#189), one per common search, written to dist/alternatives/<slug>/. Each lists the active entries that match: any id in `ids`, or an entry in one of `categories` that carries one of `tags` or `subcategories`, less any id in `exclude`. Name the paid product only to describe the search; `context` says what it is and what to look for here, with no claims about it. The build fails when a page matches fewer than three active entries.

pages.title: Free alternatives to Synty low-poly packs
pages.context: Synty sells themed low-poly 3D packs (towns, dungeons, sci-fi) for game engines. These catalog sources offer free low-poly 3D kits and characters in a similar flat, stylised look; each card shows the licence as read at the source.

pages.title: Free alternatives to Mixamo
pages.context: Mixamo is Adobe's online service for rigging characters and applying motion-capture animations. These catalog sources are free animation libraries, motion capture and rigging tools you can download and use directly.

pages.title: Free alternatives to Quixel Megascans
pages.context: Megascans is a library of scanned 3D assets and surfaces, now sold through Fab. These catalog sources offer free PBR textures, scanned models and HDRI skies.

pages.title: Free alternatives to Aseprite
pages.context: Aseprite is a paid pixel-art and sprite animation editor. These catalog sources are free pixel-art editors and sprite tools; each tool's own licence is separate from the art you make with it.

pages.title: Free alternatives to Substance Painter
pages.context: Substance 3D Painter is Adobe's paid tool for painting textures onto 3D models. These catalog sources are free texturing, material and painting tools.

pages.title: Free alternatives to stock music subscriptions
pages.context: Subscription libraries license music for videos and games for a monthly fee. These catalog sources offer free music for games; several ask for credit, and each card shows what the licence asks.
